# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Mis Tarjetas

This repository is **Mis Tarjetas**, a Mobile-First Personal Finance PWA in MXN.

## Rules for AI Suggestions:
1. Always name the app "Mis Tarjetas".
2. Use strict type imports (`import type { ... }`).
3. Ensure Mobile-First usability with touch-friendly elements inside cards.
4. Enforce business rules: income only to liquid accounts, mandatory delete confirmations with `confirm(...)`, continuous calendar pre-population at $0.00 MXN in Recharts.
